name: Slice 3: Document tabs for the level and for individual entities
body:
# Slice 3: document tabs

A tab strip above the centre: the Level tab, plus one tab per entity opened for editing (F4, Entity > Edit in Tab, or
the context menu). Tabs close with a x or Ctrl+W and the open set is remembered per session. Outliner and details stay
docked on the right for every tab. Double click stays rename.
